title: Evidence Engineering 12-in-1 Adjustable Gravity Stem
content:
Evidence Engineering, a new company from Poland, has released its first product: an adjustable stem with 12 settings to dial in the perfect cockpit position on your trail, enduro, or downhill bike. Read below for all of the adjustable details. And yes, it reminds us of a Bionicle…

Evidence Engineering Adjustable Stem Quick Hits

  • Reach (Length) adjustability – 20 / 30 / 35 / 45 mm
  • Stack (Rise) adjustability – 33 / 45 mm
  • Handlebar clamp width adjustability – 58 / 70 mm
  • Handlebar diameter – 35 mm only
  • Steerer diameter – 11⁄8” (28.6 mm)
  • Steerer clamp height – 24 mm
  • Min. steerer insertion – 21 mm
  • Intended use – Trail / Enduro / Gravity / E-bikes – ASTM cat. 5
  • Max system weight (bike + rider + gear) – 130 kg
  • Made in Poland

Adjustments

This stem design features 6 possible combinations of reach and stack (Fig. F-K) and 2 clamping widths available (Fig. L, M). Pay attention to the markings on the side of the stem to find out your current reach and stack. There are 4 reach configurations: 20, 30, 35, 45 mm. The 20 and 30 mm reach options are available only when using a 45 mm stack setup. To adjust the reach, bolt the clamps to the base with different holes and rotate the base around the steerer tube if necessary. There are 2 stack (rise) options – 33 and 45 mm. To change the stack height, flip only the stem base upside down. There are 2 handlebar clamp width options: 58 and 70 mm (Fig. L, M). You can run either width, regardless of your reach and stack choice. To adjust the clamping width, swap the left and right handlebar clamps. Always check if the handlebar clamping zone is straight and wide enough (Fig. D, E). Many handlebars may not be compatible with the 70mm width setup, and there may be some handlebars that are not compatible with either width setup. Please contact Evidence Engineering if you have any concerns about the handlebar compatibility.
